g.text: I-ITSM | Exception hierarchy, application and demo initialization
AppException extends framework RuntimeException and carries HttpStatus.
GlobalExceptionHandler maps domain, authorization, validation and persistence exceptions.
DemoDataInitializer implements ApplicationRunner; Application is the Spring Boot entry point.
Solid hollow triangle: inheritance | Dashed hollow triangle: interface realization
Filled diamond: composition | Hollow diamond: shared aggregation
Arrow: stored association | Dashed arrow: dependency
Source snapshot: 22 November 2026 | com.iitsm backend | Explicit members; generated accessors omitted
